entries.what: Walks the 12 minutes down Vinca to Flats High, sits through geometry and English, and eats lunch at the B wing planters with Brianna, Karina and Sienna.
entries.outcome: Normal day; the group plans Brianna's birthday party for Sunday night.

entries.what: Evening at unit 114 with Yesenia, who is home by 3:30 from her St. Anselm shift. Dulce counts her phone fund out loud and checks her chat.
entries.outcome: Goes to bed around 11:30 after a late group chat.

entries.what: Third period chemistry with Ms. Tolentino: molar mass practice, lab partner Karina. Lunch is back at the planters.
entries.outcome: Gets the problems done fast and starts the lab write-up.

entries.what: After school, Dulce takes the 22 bus to Calle Ortega with a friend for boba, then heads home. Yesenia mentions the hospital's new charting system has everyone at St. Anselm stressed.
entries.outcome: Spends a few dollars on drinks again and hears about work stress at home.

entries.what: Chemistry lab day. Dulce finishes the molar mass calculations in seconds but stalls on the lab conclusion.
entries.outcome: Leaves the conclusion for the evening.

entries.what: At home that evening, Dulce asks the assistant to just tell her what a conclusion is supposed to say. The math part is already done.
entries.outcome: Gets a short outline and writes three sentences.

entries.what: School day, then Dulce does homework at the kitchen table in unit 114 and finishes the lab conclusion.
entries.outcome: Turns it into a full paragraph and packs her bag for the shift tomorrow.

entries.what: Dulce texts Karina about Saturday's street fair and sees the group chat go quiet, then comes back to jokes.
entries.outcome: Plans to go to the fair with Karina after Saturday laundry.

entries.what: Fifth period PE volleyball, then the 22 bus to Calle Ortega for her 4-9 shift at Taquería Colima. Héctor's rancheras play behind the grill.
entries.outcome: Takes orders through the after-shift rush.

entries.what: At close, Efraín lets Dulce count the drawer because she makes change faster than the register. She gets it to the penny on her own.
entries.outcome: Trusted with the drawer from now on.

entries.what: Rafael picks Dulce up after the 9 p.m. close and drives her home. She tells him about the drawer, and he says Tía Gladys will be proud.
entries.outcome: Gets home before 10 and tells her mom the news.

entries.what: Saturday laundry at the card-only laundry room, then Dulce and Karina walk the Calle Ortega Street Fair, with food stalls, live music and a crowded Panadería Las Hermanas.
entries.outcome: Spends only a few dollars on a concha and an agua fresca.

entries.what: Dulce stops by Taquería Colima's fair stall to say hi to Efraín, then Brianna texts to confirm Dulce is coming to the birthday party.
entries.outcome: Says yes to Brianna, forgetting she is on the Sunday shift.

entries.what: Evening at home; Dulce realizes the party clashes with her Sunday 10-4 shift and thinks about how to fix it.
entries.outcome: Decides to ask Camila about covering.

entries.what: Dulce pays Camila $20 to cover her Sunday shift so she can go to Brianna's party that night, a one-off because the party fell on her shift. She owes Camila until she can pay her back.
entries.outcome: Camila agrees; Dulce still owes her $20.

entries.what: Having said yes to both Camila and Brianna, Dulce asks the assistant to help write a message to Efraín explaining the swap.
entries.outcome: Sends a polite note and hopes he's not mad.

entries.what: Dulce goes to Brianna's birthday party and then home, where Yesenia is waiting.
entries.outcome: Gets in on time for Yesenia's rule.
